name: aurora
description: Violet into cyan. Fluid, always folding.
author: chalktalk

name: bubble
description: A soap bubble. Its colours are real thin-film light; it ripples, swirls and streams with every state, and pops when something fails.
author: chalktalk

name: ember
description: Molten and heavy. It glows from within.
author: chalktalk

name: ferro
description: Black chrome ferrofluid with a molten core. It stretches, twists and ripples with every state.
author: chalktalk

name: iris
description: Tight violet folds that turn like petals.
author: chalktalk

name: lagoon
description: Cyan and green water. Long waves, like a tide.
author: chalktalk

name: lattice
description: A rigid sphere of dots. Only the light moves.
author: chalktalk

name: mercury
description: A drop of liquid silver. It weaves itself into a knot to work, turns to gold when it's done, and tarnishes when it fails.
author: chalktalk

name: mist
description: Colour bleeding through air, like watercolour.
author: chalktalk

name: moss
description: Organic and lumpy. It grows and creeps.
author: chalktalk

name: nova
description: Fine and fast. A star that can't sit still.
author: chalktalk

name: pearl
description: A clear bubble with one bead of light inside.
author: chalktalk

name: rose
description: Pink glass with a heartbeat inside.
author: chalktalk

name: signal
description: A body of dots trying to get out. Every state moves its own way.
author: chalktalk
